kept.q: The variable y varies directly as x. When x = 5, y = 20. Find the value of y when x = 8.
kept.explanation: Since y varies directly as x, y = kx. Using x=5, y=20: 20 = 5k, so k = 4. When x = 8, y = 4 x 8 = 32.
kept.pidgin: Since y dey vary direct with x, y = kx. From x=5, y=20, we see say k = 4. So when x = 8, y = 4 x 8 = 32.

kept.q: The variable p varies inversely as q. When q = 4, p = 15. Find the value of p when q = 10.
kept.explanation: Since p varies inversely as q, p = k/q. Using q=4, p=15: k = p x q = 60. When q = 10, p = 60/10 = 6.
kept.pidgin: Since p dey vary inverse with q, p = k/q. From q=4, p=15, k = 15 x 4 = 60. So when q=10, p = 60/10 = 6.

kept.q: Z varies jointly as x and the square of y. When x = 2 and y = 3, Z = 72. Find Z when x = 5 and y = 2.
T varies partly as m and partly as the square of n. When m = 1 and n = 1, T = 10. When m = 2 and n = 2, T = 22. Find T when m = 3 and n = 3.
kept.explanation: Let T = am + bn^2. From the data: a + b = 10 and 2a + 4b = 22, which simplifies to a + 2b = 11. Subtracting gives b = 1 and a = 9. When m=3, n=3: T = 9(3) + 1(9) = 27 + 9 = 36.
kept.pidgin: Make T = am + bn^2. From the data: a + b = 10 and a + 2b = 11. We subtract am find b = 1 and a = 9. When m=3, n=3: T = 9(3) + 1(9) = 36.
